newsitem.title: USA: Cisco launches low-density Ethernet switch.
newsitem.headline: Cisco launches low-density Ethernet switch.

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc on Monday said it expanded its Catalyst 1900 series of Ethernet workgroup switches with the introduction of a low-density version called Catalyst 1912.
The switch delivers Cisco's Ethernet technology to smaller workgroups with high-performance LAN requirements.
The Catalyst 1912 will become available in March and distributed through Cisco's resellers worldwide. The U.S. list price for the 14-port switch is $2,495.
The product is being targeted at small and medium-sized businesses and branch offices of larger enterprises.

The Catalyst 1912 is the first switch designed by Cisco to meet the needs of smaller workgroups with lower requirements for switching port density. The new fixed-configuration switch allows users to take advantage of high-speed applications and reduce server bottlenecks at a low cost.
